messages.content: Search for regulatory changes published or proposed in the last 90 days that would create compliance obligations for GetixHealth, a company in the "Healthcare" sector headquartered in Houston, Texas. Include federal, state/local, and (if applicable) foreign regulators. For each distinct item found, report: the exact rule or document title, the issuing regulator/agency, the jurisdiction, the publication or effective date, a one-sentence plain-language summary, which of the company's known facts (sector, location, activity) it applies to, and the official source URL. Only include items you found real sources for — do not invent items. Known facts about the company — website https://getixhealth.test; what it does: Revenue cycle management; operates in: United States.
